opening.argument: The video presents a straightforward consumer redemption process for two stated benefits: a Restaurant.com dinner credit and Fandango movie tickets. Viewers are instructed to select “Redeem Dinner Now,” enter a ZIP code, and search for a restaurant, while the displayed material visibly includes a Restaurant.com eGift Card and a separate movie-ticket redemption section. The movie benefit likewise follows an ordinary promotional checkout flow: viewers copy a Fandango code, use the movie redemption option, and apply the code during purchase. These restaurant-selection and promo-code steps are consistent with routine gift-card and loyalty redemption, and the supplied evidence shows no deceptive conduct.
